user.title: Webasto Cool Top Trail
user.description: Pair the IR bridge with the built-in ESPHome integration first, then select it here. Controls are available right away, starting from default settings: off, heat/cool, 22 °C, high fan. If the bridge has an IR receiver, settings made with the handheld remote are picked up automatically. IR provides no appliance feedback; room temperature is optional.
